blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Members of the prosecution panel believe the decision of Vice President Sara Duterte’s legal team to withdraw the presentation of a Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) official was brought by a yearning to play safe. The prosecutors think that if the defense team will push through with its plan, the action might have led to more information against their client. The prosecution made the observation in a press briefing on Thursday, after the 43rd day of Duterte’s impeachment trial at the Senate. Public prosecutor Manila Rep.
